records.subject: Welcome to Wrenfield, Granite Labs!
records.body:
Hi Zara,

Thanks for setting up Granite Labs on Wrenfield. If your team is more than one person, inviting them now tends to pay off -- Wrenfield is built around teammates working on shared tasks, not solo lists.

Let me know how the first week goes.

Best,
Nadia Goldberg

decisions.rationale: 6 days in, no project, no invite, no key milestone, no tickets. Three outbound touches (email:2e6a309e, email:df0e9f14, email:f6e64dcf) drew zero customer reply, suggesting disengagement rather than slow start. Starter solo account with 8 days left; unaided self-activation unlikely.

draft.subject: One first project in Wrenfield?
draft.body:
Hi Zara,

I know a new tool is easy to set aside in a busy week, so I'll keep this brief. In Wrenfield, projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them, so one real project is usually the quickest way to see whether it fits how Granite Labs works. The in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project, and if it's useful, teammates can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Would a 15-minute call this week help? I'm happy to work through that first project with you.

Best,
Nadia
